follow_ons: The reviewed manifest leaves negative_control_log empty although the run holds a genuine red control at receipt-cpu-vmap.log (node_psi 15 mismatches, EXIT_STATUS=1); recording it would make the reviewed record self-describing.

Caveat to carry into any production routing decision: the batched device arms replicate ONE carrier across the batch (_arguments docstring, 'Repeat one physical carrier into a same-shaped batch'), so the batch-64 census speedup models 64 same-shaped fields; distinct census carriers of differing shape would not vectorise the same way.

The H200 parallel union-find path is benchmark-only; promote it into nova/ under its own review before any production batch or census routes to it, and do not select the existing device vmap for any measured use.
Warm execute is a single post-compile sample per fixture and compile is a cold-minus-warm proxy; averaging over repeats would tighten the walls if a production threshold is later set from them.

Its gate logs are the two receipt comparators, both EXIT_STATUS=0 on all seven fields. added_failure_count 0 and added_failure_ids [] follow from the absence of a baseline/after suite pair together with the absence of any test-file change in the reviewed commit.

justifications.durability: The benchmark is committed and re-runnable against the committed fixture factories, the fragment carries the decision and the figure, and the arm logs and per-fixture measurements are durable under the run directory. The recommendation is not yet wired into any executable routing default, which is correct for a measure-then-recommend node but means the decision is not yet load-bearing.
justifications.evidence: The fragment table was recomputed from combined-host-input.json and matches exactly; the committed comparator reports 0 mismatches on all seven fields for the recorded receipts; an independent CPU arm at head 4b55fc0a with the persisted carrier inputs reproduces the identity against both recorded device arms end-to-end; and a mutated receipt makes the comparator name the altered field and exit 1. Weakness: each fixture's warm execute is a single post-compile sample rather than an average over repeats, and compile is a cold-minus-warm proxy, both disclosed in the fragment.
justifications.fit: The work answers plan section f-ctta-sweep-device-placement and keeps the production route untouched. Minor fit cost: the fragment's 'Placement:' paragraph reads as a usable routing recommendation while the parallel union-find path is benchmark-only, so a reader who stops at that paragraph could read the prototype as production-ready; the manifest and fragment intro do state it is a prototype.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Every element the followup asked for is present: three placements (host serial single field, device vmap of the existing sweep, device parallel union-find prototype), batch sizes 1, 8 and 64, all 12 certificate rungs plus the 2 MAST carriers, compile and warm execute walls reported per placement, a per-use recommendation (single solve -> host CPU; labeller batch 8 and census 64 -> H200 parallel prototype), and receipt identity checked with the committed --compare mode.
justifications.scope_discipline: Commit 4b55fc0a touches exactly the three node-owned paths (benchmark, evidence fragment, figure) and modifies no production code; the benchmark imports private sweep helpers but changes none of them.
